purpose: Regression cases for high-value Toolkit API discovery hints that should not silently disappear or drift to invented names.

cases.userIntent: ignore helper geometry during click or XR selection instead of inventing a custom raycast exclusion helper
fire a zone trigger only for the player or for entities with specific tags without bespoke polling or collision glue
target a named quest and task and advance built-in progress instead of splitting quest state across custom handlers
attach Toolkit media controls to an existing video surface instead of rebuilding play pause volume and seek UI
attach Toolkit audio controls to an existing sound component and target the correct slot instead of custom audio UI
